review.notes: Full review of a repaired head. The twelve findings of the previous review are repaired (the Vostokov sign partly). Fesenko 1991a, 1991b, 2001 not readable. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with three sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes close nothing; 18 cross-roadmap citations and 9 library declarations resolved. Findings: build-order cycle in mixed characteristic (3.2(b), 2.4, 2.5 need 5.4a and the explicit pairings); 5.2 length-r formula through ghost components; 5.2 annihilators without finite index; Teichmuller representatives called a field in mixed characteristic; supplier section 3a.1 covers Galois extensions only.
